purpose: Teach: コンビネーション/クズ/適格/供与/にあたり/勲章/公聴/意匠

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査チームの編成、つまりコンビネーションを慎重に考慮されますね
lines.en: The police take care to thoughtfully organize their investigative teams and coordinate their efforts, don't they.
lines.style: Measured, respectful tone acknowledging bureaucratic precision. Slight upward inflection at the end—genuine question, not sarcasm. Steady pace, collaborative energy.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、クズ、つまりクズ鉄の盗難事案にも対応されますね
lines.en: The police handle scrap metal theft cases with attention, isn't that right.
lines.style: Same measured respect, but grounding the scope—moving from abstract process to concrete crime type. Tone stays collaborative. Small pause before the question tag.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査の適格者を慎重に配置されますね
lines.en: The police carefully place the right investigators where they're needed, don't they.
lines.style: Warm specificity now. Less procedural, more human-focused. Slight emphasis on 'right'—recognizing skill and fit. Still collaborative, less formal.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民への情報供与には、警察、慎重に対応されますね
lines.en: The police are careful about how they share information with the public, aren't they.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost protective tone. Acknowledging the sensitivity and responsibility involved. Softer attack. Slight trailing thoughtfulness at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査開始にあたり、ご家族に説明されますね
lines.en: When the police start an investigation, they explain things to the family first, right.
lines.style: Gentler shift—moving to human vulnerability. Slow, considerate pace. Quiet certainty about this being the right way. Warm but not patronizing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、警察功労者勲章の授与式もされますね
lines.en: The police also hold award ceremonies for their dedicated officers, don't they.
lines.style: Lighter touch here—acknowledging achievement and recognition. Slight warmth, even brightness in tone. Still respectful but less weighted than before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、議会の公聴会にも出席されますね
lines.en: The police attend public hearings in the parliament, isn't that so.
lines.style: Returning to measured respect. Scope widening again—institutional engagement. Steady, formal-ish but not cold. Question-tag is genuine curiosity about the breadth of their role.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、現場の意匠、つまり意匠の独自性も鑑識されますね
lines.en: The police even examine the unique design characteristics at crime scenes, don't they.
lines.style: Shift to precision and expertise. Slightly slower on 'examine'—drawing attention to the technical skill. Close attention to detail. Quieter, more focused energy than the earlier lines.
